verdict_reason: Key selection by kid and per-provider aud/iss checks are correct and tested, and the stub path keeps its real prior behaviour (old code passed aud/iss in the key argument, which @hapi/jwt ignores); one Major naming finding on the decoded artifacts local.

todos.issue: const decoded = Jwt.token.decode(token) (line 22) holds @hapi/jwt's artifacts object ({ token, decoded, raw }), not the decoded token, so line 23 reads decoded.decoded.header and line 35 passes 'decoded' to Jwt.token.verify, which takes artifacts. The name mispredicts the value it holds.
todos.fix: Must: the local that holds the result of Jwt.token.decode is named for what it is, so the header read and the verify call read without a doubled 'decoded'. One way: rename it to 'artifacts' (the term @hapi/jwt uses) and read 'const { kid } = artifacts.decoded.header'.
